facts.text: The Atlantic course opened in 1992 and staged the Portuguese Open two years later.
facts.excerpt: The 18-hole Atlantic course designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr., opened in 1992 and staged the Portuguese Open two years later.

facts.text: The spa, guided by Zen philosophy, occupies its own building within the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park.
